sloka: प्राणैरपि प्रियं कार्यं देवानां हि सदा मया ।सो ऽहं वो निहनिष्यामि रसातलगतानपि ।। ७.८.८ ॥
transliteration: prāṇairapi priyaṁ kāryaṁ devānāṁ hi sadā mayā ।so 'haṁ vo nihaniṣyāmi rasātalagatānapi ।। 7.8.8 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, the welfare of the gods is dearer to me than my own life, and therefore I will kill you all, even if you hide in the lowest netherworld.
